review.imagery: Twelve project renders were visually reviewed. Eight native brochure scenes and four wider current-gallery compositions cover the exterior, balcony pools, entrance, rooftop and shared pools, home interiors, gym and spa. The wide complete building view supplies the card and hero. Duplicate cropped versions and generic island/people photographs are excluded. Proposed interiors remain unit-unspecific. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Seven complete home drawings and eight building sheets retain their original floor/unit keys. No numerical unit areas are printed on these sheets. The podium one-bedroom drawing has no pool. The seventh/eighth-floor tables retain a copied first-floor heading. Confirm the approved configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. All fifteen original brochure sheets on physical pages 21–35 were individually reviewed. The seven home drawings preserve floor and unit applicability, including podium homes and pool-equipped variants. The official brochure already contains the sheets found in the broker-hosted plan pack, so the official original is used. Broad FAQ minimum areas are not assigned to particular drawings.
review.location: Complete original brochure map page 6 and travel panel page 10 were visually reviewed. The published name-only map query is saved with the primary source hash. The regional marker is not georeferenced. Brochure versus primary travel differences remain explicit. No road distance, live route or entrance coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML, original official brochure and fact sheet retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. The broker-hosted plan pack was inspected for comparison but is unnecessary for delivery because its sheets also appear in the official brochure. Native image origins, complete drawing notices and physical-page links remain available. Protected text research is preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific home areas, a reliable plot/entrance coordinate, final unit fitout and dated construction photographs were not established. Conflicting published inventory counts remain qualified in the existing research.
